name: PiML_benchmark_runs
description: A collection of benchmark run records from the PiML benchmarking effort, containing model configurations, per-run metrics, and logs to enable analysis and comparison of model performance across tasks and settings. Intended for post-hoc analysis of experiment results, reproducibility checks, and meta-evaluation of benchmarking procedures.
reputation: Niche dataset with limited adoption outside the originating research group; primarily used by researchers analyzing PiML experiments and reproducibility.
